title: 第3章  拿什么养活我？
slug: 凡人从拔刀三十万次开始
content_zh:
“小叔，修炼刀法，光拔刀可没用，得去练习劈、砍、撩、刺、缠头、裹脑……，等等基本的用刀动作。”
苏晴柔看到陈时安一直不停地拔刀收刀，实在忍不住，小声地提醒。
她虽然没修炼过，但没少看丈夫练刀，对刀法多少有些了解。
陈时安微微一笑，一本正经地说道：“嫂嫂，你说的那些基本动作固然重要，但拔刀比它们更重要。
对敌之时，如果我拔刀的速度比别人快，那就能抢占先机。
故而，要练刀，就得先练习拔刀术。”
苏晴柔正要说话，陈甜甜走了过来，把小嘴一撇，“还真以为你转了性，要改过自新。
现在看来，还和先前一个样，偷奸耍滑，吃不得半点苦。
就你这么一个练刀法，练上一百年，都是白搭……………。”
“甜甜！”
苏晴柔连忙止住女儿的话头，并朝着陈时安挤出笑容，“小叔，甜甜还小，童言无忌，你别往心里去。”
陈时安嘴角轻翘，“甜甜，如果小叔哪天把刀法给练成了，你怎么说？”
陈甜甜脱口而出，“你若是能练成刀法，我天天给你倒洗脚水！”
“乖侄女，到时候，你可千万别反悔。”陈时安笑容灿烂。
陈甜甜轻哼，“你如果练不成刀法，又怎么说？”
“这种假设不存在。”陈时安把话说完，直接抬脚回屋，留给陈甜甜一个后脑勺。
……………
拔刀不到四十次，胳膊便酸得抬不起来。
陈时安斜靠在椅子里，一脸的无奈。
原主的身子骨实在太废，一柄十斤不到的刀，才拔上三十多次，就不得不停下来休息。

以这种进度，要拔刀三十万次，至少也得三两个月的时间。
靠拔刀成为入品武者解决眼前的难题，肯定不赶趟。
陈时安紧皱起眉头，苦苦思索对策。
突然，他眼睛一亮，脑中闪过一个念头。
连忙抓起桌上的刀，将刀拔出半截，并看向了脑海中的石碑。
令他惊喜的是，石碑上的拔刀次数居然增加了。
原来，并不需要将刀完全拔出来。
于是，他继续试验。
跑去厨房，拿了柴刀、菜刀………
最后，他得出结论，刀得是正儿八经的带鞘刀，重量还不能轻了，至少得有六斤，并且最少要拔出两寸，石碑上的拔刀次数才会增加。
拔刀两寸，省时又省力。
陈时安自然是高兴不已，待到胳膊的酸胀稍减，继续拔刀…………
不过，要赶在交城建税以前拔刀三十万次，时间仍旧远远不够。
要解决眼前的问题，还得想其他的出路。
…………
拔刀两百次，陈时安的一双胳膊已经酸得抬不起来。
于是，他放下横刀，和苏晴柔打了声招呼，又出门去了。
苏晴柔看到小叔子进进出出，心里边很是狐疑，但又不敢多问。
……………
风起城寨的东边，有一处集市，聚集着做各种生意的商户，其中便包括做布匹生意的方家。

陈时安坐在方家客厅，没人过来沏茶，等了约莫半个时辰，身材矮胖的方明才慢悠悠地走了进来。
“陈贤侄，不好意思，被一些事情耽搁，让你久等了。”方明嘴里说着不好意思，头颅却是高抬着，脸上挂着倨傲的表情。
他一屁股坐在主位上，“令兄遭受不幸，实在令人惋惜，我原本打算过去探望，不想店里的事情一桩接一桩，实在走不开。
等哪天忙完，我便带着家人过去祭奠。”
“方掌柜有心了。”
陈时安淡淡回应，“我今日过来，是为了如玉的婚事。
陈家遭受不幸，我打算近日便和如玉完婚，以做冲喜。”
闻言，方明脸皮一僵，稍作犹豫，低声道：“陈贤侄的想法，我是赞同的。
不过，你要和如玉完婚，怎么也得等到令兄做七之后。”
陈时安眼皮轻抬，“做七之后，方掌柜恐怕又会找出其他理由，继续往后拖吧？”
说到这里，他提高了音量，“现今，我大哥不在了，照顾不到方家的生意。
方掌柜不同意我和如玉的婚事，也算人之常情。
但是，就这么一直拖着，终究不是解决问题的办法。”
方明老脸一红，“陈贤侄，你这是什么话，我何时不同意了…………。”
陈时安把手一挥，“方掌柜，话已挑明，你也就坦诚一些，把如玉请出来，我想听听她的意思。
咱们今天当面锣对面鼓，把话说清楚，解决问题。
若是方掌柜还要搪塞，便是赖婚，我会去城衙告状。”
闻言，方明变了脸色，连忙说道：“陈贤侄，你误会了，我们方家可没有赖婚的意思…………。”
“既然不想赖婚，婚期已经拖了半年，我们两家明日便将婚事给办了，如何？”陈时安微抬头颅。
方明满脸为难之色，“陈贤侄，你如今还在丧期，明日便大婚，恐怕不妥当………。”

“婚礼一切从简，在我大哥的灵前举行简朴的拜堂仪式，以告慰他的在天之灵，不违守孝之节。”陈时安早有预案。
方明支支吾吾，正要找说辞，一道靓丽身影迈过门槛，走了进来。
来人是一位年轻女孩，容貌精致俏丽，身材修长窈窕，一袭水绿长裙，腰间纹绣着一朵白色莲花。
她正是陈时安的未婚妻，方明的女儿，方如玉。
“陈时安，我若是嫁入陈家，你拿不起锄头，挥不动猎刀，拉不开弓箭，拿什么养活我？”
方如玉站在客厅中央，螓首微抬，表情冷淡地盯着陈时安，眼神中的轻视和厌恶，没有做半分的掩饰。
方家和陈家之所以订下姻亲，自然不是看上了陈时安这个惫懒货，而是因为他的大哥。
城卫营在风起城寨职责甚广，征伐、安防、稽查…………
陈时安的大哥乃是城卫营的什长，多少能照顾到方家的生意。
如今，陈时安的大哥已去，方家如何还肯认这门亲事。
陈时安起得身来，嘴角微翘，“能不能养得活，只有嫁了，才知道。”
“你一个不学无术的惫懒货，除了赌博，你还会什么，没了你大哥，你连自己都养不活。”
方如玉嗤之以鼻。
陈时安的脸上露出浅浅的笑容，“这么说，方小姐已经决定要悔婚？”
方如玉轻哼，“嫁给你这么一个无用的赌徒，就等于跳进火坑。换做是谁，也不想往火坑里跳…………。”
“如玉，不可胡说。”
方明连忙止住方如玉，并对着陈时安连连拱手，”陈贤侄，你莫要当真，如玉不过是说气话，不是真要悔婚？”
在风起城寨，男方若是悔婚，所交的聘礼，女方不予退还；女方若是悔婚，便得将聘礼归还男方，而且得是双倍归还。
陈时安今日来方家，目的不是要和方如玉完婚。
方如玉长得的确不俗，但是，她打心眼里瞧不上原主，陈时安可没做舔狗的习惯。

他想要拿回当初下的聘礼——六两银子。双倍归还，那就是十二两。
若是能拿到十二两银子，眼前的难关就能度过去。
不过，方家早已不想和陈家结亲，却始终不肯做出悔婚之举，一拖再拖，就是要激怒陈时安，让他做出错事，从而有理由退了这桩婚事。
目的，不想赔双倍的聘礼。
陈时安洞悉了方家的意图，一到方家，便摆出咄咄逼人的架势，就是要逼迫方家主动悔婚。
方明沉得住气，方如玉却是太过年轻，一个没忍住，终于说出了心里的想法。
“方掌柜，你还有何话要说？”陈时安表情不变，语气低沉。
“陈贤侄，如玉从小被我惯坏，说起话来只图口快…………”方明赶紧找补。
陈时安把嘴一撇，“既然方掌柜和方小姐都在，今日便把话挑明，婚事拖了这么久，我已不想再拖。
明日，我就要和方小姐成婚。
若是你们方家不答应，我便把你们告上城衙，告你们赖婚，请城衙的大人们替我做主！”
这一番话说得斩钉截铁，没有半分商量的余地。
方明脸色大变，急急出声：“如玉，你看你这孩子，总由着性子说胡话，赶紧给陈贤侄道歉…………。”
“父亲，你自己已经否了这门婚事，还遮遮掩掩做什么？”
方如玉挥手将父亲打断，“陈时安就是一个赌徒、赌棍，我即便是死，也不会嫁给他。
父亲，悔婚不过是给他十二两银子而已，和女儿的终身幸福比起来，又算得了什么。
更何况，我昨天已经通过了考核，马上就能进入风起武院学习，便有机会拜入城寨的入品武者门下，将来更是可能成为入品武者。
现在，即便一百个陈时安加起来，也配不上女儿。
早点了断婚约，对女儿、对我们方家，都是最好的选择。”
content_en:
"Uncle, when practicing sword skills, it's no use just drawing the sword. You have to practice chopping, chopping, teasing, stabbing, wrapping the head, wrapping the brain... and other basic knife movements."
Su Qingrou saw that Chen Shi'an kept drawing out the sword and putting it away, so she couldn't help it and reminded her in a low voice.
Although she has never practiced swordsmanship, she has often watched her husband practice swordsmanship, and she has some understanding of swordsmanship.
Chen Shi'an smiled slightly and said seriously: "Sister-in-law, the basic actions you mentioned are important, but drawing the sword is more important than them.
When facing an enemy, if I can draw my sword faster than others, I can gain the upper hand.
Therefore, if you want to practice swordsmanship, you must first practice the art of drawing swords. "
Just as Su Qingrou was about to speak, Chen Tiantian came over and curled her lips, "I really thought you had changed your gender and wanted to change your past.
Now it seems that it is still the same as before, cheating and cheating, and not suffering at all.
For someone like you, practicing swordsmanship for a hundred years is all in vain... "
"Sweet!"
Su Qingrou quickly stopped her daughter's words and smiled at Chen Shi'an, "Uncle, Tiantian is still young, and her childish words are innocent, so don't take it to heart."
The corners of Chen Shi'an's lips curled up slightly, "Tiantian, if my uncle masters sword skills one day, what will you say?"
Chen Tiantian blurted out, "If you can practice sword skills, I will pour water for your feet every day!"
"Good niece, don't regret it when the time comes." Chen Shi'an smiled brightly.
Chen Tiantian hummed, "What if you can't practice sword skills?"
"This assumption does not exist." After Chen Shi'an finished speaking, he walked directly back to the house, leaving Chen Tiantian with a slap on the back of her head.
……………
After drawing the sword less than forty times, my arm was so sore that I couldn't lift it.
Chen Shi'an leaned back in his chair with a look of helplessness on his face.
The original owner's body was so weak that he had to stop and rest after only pulling out a knife weighing less than ten kilograms thirty times.
At this pace, it would take at least three or two months to draw the sword 300,000 times.
Relying on drawing a sword to become a top-grade warrior to solve the problems at hand is definitely not a rush.
Chen Shi'an frowned and thought hard about countermeasures.
Suddenly, his eyes lit up and an idea flashed through his mind.
He quickly grabbed the knife on the table, pulled out half of it, and looked at the stone tablet in his mind.
To his surprise, the number of sword draws on the stone tablet actually increased.
It turns out that there is no need to completely pull out the knife.
So he continued experimenting.
I ran to the kitchen and got a hatchet, a kitchen knife...
Finally, he came to the conclusion that the sword must be a serious sheathed sword that cannot be light in weight. It must weigh at least six kilograms and must be drawn out at least two inches. The number of times the sword must be drawn on the stone tablet will increase.
Drawing the sword only two inches saves time and effort.
Chen Shi'an was naturally very happy. When the soreness in his arm subsided a little, he continued to draw the knife...
However, there is still not enough time to draw the sword 300,000 times before paying the city construction tax.
To solve the current problem, we have to think of other ways out.
…………
After drawing the sword two hundred times, Chen Shian's arms were so sore that he couldn't lift them up.
So, he put down the horizontal knife, said hello to Su Qingrou, and went out again.
Su Qingrou was very suspicious when she saw her brother-in-law coming in and out, but she didn't dare to ask any more questions.
……………
To the east of Fengqi Walled City, there is a market where merchants engaged in various businesses gather, including the Fang family, who is engaged in cloth business.
Chen Shi'an was sitting in the Fang family's living room. No one came to make tea. After waiting for about half an hour, the short and fat Fang Ming walked in slowly.
"Nephew Chen Xian, I'm sorry, I was delayed by some things and kept you waiting for a long time." Fang Ming said sorry, but he held his head high with a haughty expression on his face.
He sat down on the main seat and said, "It's really a pity that my brother has suffered such misfortune. I originally planned to visit him, but things in the store kept happening one after another and I really couldn't leave.
When I finish my work one day, I will take my family with meGo and pay homage. "
"Shopkeeper Fang is interested. "
Chen Shi'an responded calmly, "I came here today for Ruyu's marriage.
The Chen family has suffered a misfortune, and I plan to marry Ruyu in the near future to celebrate the occasion. "
Hearing this, Fang Ming's face froze, hesitated for a moment, and whispered: "I agree with nephew Chen Xian's idea.
However, if you want to marry Ruyu, you have to wait until your brother is married. "
Chen Shi'an raised his eyelids slightly, "After doing seven, I'm afraid shopkeeper Fang will find other reasons to keep delaying it, right? "
Speaking of this, he raised his voice, "Now that my eldest brother is gone, I can't take care of the Fang family's business.
Shopkeeper Fang disagrees with my marriage to Ruyu, which is human nature.
However, just procrastinating like this is not the solution to the problem after all. "
Fang Ming's old face turned red, "Nephew Chen Xian, what are you saying? When did I disagree..." "
Chen Shi'an waved his hand and said, "Shopkeeper Fang, I've made it clear, so you should be more honest and invite Ruyu out. I want to hear what she means.
Let's talk clearly and solve the problem in person today.
If shopkeeper Fang continues to prevaricate, it means he is refusing to marry me, and I will go to the city government to file a complaint. "
Hearing this, Fang Ming's expression changed and he quickly said: "Nephew Chen Xian, you misunderstood, our Fang family has no intention of refusing to marry... "
"Since we don't want to delay the marriage and the wedding has been postponed for half a year, our two families will arrange the wedding tomorrow. How about it? "Chen Shi'an raised his head slightly.
Fang Ming's face was full of embarrassment, "Nephew Chen Xian, you are still in the period of mourning, and I'm afraid it won't be appropriate to get married tomorrow..." "
"Everything about the wedding was simple. A simple worship ceremony was held in front of my eldest brother's soul to comfort his spirit in heaven and not to violate the filial piety. "Chen Shi'an had already made a plan.
Fang Ming hesitated and was about to find an excuse when a beautiful figure stepped across the threshold and walked in.
The person who came was a young girl with delicate and pretty appearance, slender figure, wearing a long aqua skirt with a white lotus embroidered on her waist.
She is Chen Shi'an's fiancee, Fang Ming's daughter, Fang Ruyu.
"Chen Shi'an, if I marry into the Chen family and you can't pick up a hoe, wield a hunting knife, or draw a bow and arrow, how will you support me? "
Fang Ruyu stood in the center of the living room, raising her head slightly and staring at Chen Shi'an with a cold expression. The contempt and disgust in her eyes were not concealed at all.
The reason why the Fang family and the Chen family made an in-law arrangement was naturally not because they fell in love with Chen Shi'an, a lazy guy, but because of his eldest brother.
The city guard battalion has a wide range of responsibilities in Fengqi City Walled City, including expedition, security, inspection...
Chen Shi'an's eldest brother is the chief of the city guard camp and can take care of the Fang family's business to some extent.
Now that Chen Shi'an's eldest brother has passed away, how can the Fang family still accept this marriage?
Chen Shi'an stood up and raised the corners of his mouth slightly, "Whether you can support yourself or not, you won't know until you get married. "
"You are an ignorant and lazy person. Apart from gambling, what else can you do? Without your elder brother, you can't even support yourself. "
Fang Ruyu sneered.
A faint smile appeared on Chen Shi'an's face, "So, Miss Fang has decided to regret her marriage? "
Fang Ruyu hummed, "Marrying a useless gambler like you is like jumping into a pit of fire. No one else would want to jump into the fire pit... "
“Ruyu, don’t talk nonsense. "
Fang Ming quickly stopped Fang Ruyu and repeatedly raised his hands to Chen Shi'an, "Nephew Chen Xian, don't take it seriously. Ruyu is just saying angry words. Doesn't he really want to regret his marriage?" "
In Fengqi Walled City, if the man regrets the marriage, the bride price will not be returned to the woman; if the woman regrets the marriage, the bride price must be returned to the man, and the bride price must be doubled.
Chen Shi'an came to Fang's house today not to marry Fang Ruyu.
Fang Ruyu was indeed good-looking, but she truly despised the original owner, and Chen Shi'an was not in the habit of licking dogs.
He wants to get back the betrothal gift he paid - six taelssilver. Return double, that is twelve taels.
If we can get twelve taels of silver, we can overcome the current difficulties.
However, the Fang family no longer wanted to marry the Chen family, but they still refused to regret the marriage. They kept delaying it just to anger Chen Shi'an and make him do something wrong, so as to have a reason to cancel the marriage.
The purpose is not to pay double the betrothal gift.
Chen Shi'an understood the Fang family's intentions, and as soon as he arrived at the Fang family, he put on an aggressive stance, hoping to force the Fang family to take the initiative to regret their marriage.
Fang Ming could keep his composure, but Fang Ruyu was too young to hold back and finally spoke out his inner thoughts.
"Shopkeeper Fang, what else do you have to say?" Chen Shi'an's expression remained unchanged and his tone was low.
"Nephew Chen Xian, Ruyu has been spoiled by me since she was a child. She only wants to talk quickly..." Fang Ming quickly made amends.
Chen Shi'an curled his lips, "Since Shopkeeper Fang and Miss Fang are here, I will make it clear today that the marriage has been delayed for so long and I don't want to delay it any longer.
Tomorrow, I will get married to Miss Fang.
If your Fang family doesn't agree, I will sue you to the city government and sue you for refusing to marry me. I will ask the adults in the city government to make the decision for me! "
These words were categorical and there was no room for discussion.
Fang Ming's face changed drastically and he said hastily: "Ruyu, look at this kid, you always talk nonsense out of your temper. Please apologize to Nephew Chen Xian quickly..."
"Father, you have rejected this marriage yourself, why are you still hiding it?"
Fang Ruyu interrupted her father with a wave of her hand, "Chen Shi'an is a gambler and a gambler. Even if I die, I will not marry him.
Father, if you regret your marriage, you just give him twelve taels of silver. Compared with your daughter's lifelong happiness, it is nothing.
What's more, I passed the assessment yesterday and will be able to enter the Fengqi Martial Arts Academy to study immediately. I will have the opportunity to become a disciple of a first-class warrior in the city, and I may even become a first-class warrior in the future.
Now, even if a hundred Chen Shi'an were put together, they would not be worthy of his daughter.
Breaking off the engagement early is the best choice for our daughter and our Fang family. "
